name: BattMobility

sections.title: The challenge
sections.description: How do you turn a bold idea, shared electric mobility for everyone, into a brand people trust and a business that scales? BattMobility set out to give communities freedom of movement without the burden of car ownership. Our job: shape the strategy, build the brand, and engineer the digital tools that bring Freedom in Motion to life.

sections.title: Strategy & go-to-market
sections.description: Every strong brand begins with clarity. Through research and stakeholder sessions we defined BattMobility’s purpose, positioning and proposition, then translated it into a concrete go-to-market strategy: who to reach first, what to promise, and how to grow. A roadmap that took the brand from concept to a living, growing community.

sections.title: The brand identity
sections.description: The identity had to feel human, optimistic and effortlessly modern: mobility that belongs to everyone. We designed a flexible visual language built around motion and energy, with a fresh colour palette and confident typography that works from a phone screen to the side of a vehicle.

sections.title: The design system
sections.description: To keep everything consistent as the brand scaled, we built a complete design system: the BattMobility 2025 Style Guide. Colour, type, spacing, components, iconography and rules for every touchpoint, captured as reusable tokens and templates so the team can create on-brand material at speed, without us in the room.

sections.title: AI-driven imagery
sections.description: Photography at scale is slow and expensive. We developed a bespoke AI imagery pipeline to generate on-brand visuals: people, places and vehicles in the BattMobility world. It gives the brand an endless, consistent and ownable image library for campaigns, social and product.

sections.title: Custom-built apps: the Marketing OS
sections.description: Great brands need great tools. We engineered a suite of custom applications, with a Marketing OS at its core, including a socials template builder, an email builder and more. The team now produces branded social posts and emails in minutes, fully on-system, turning the design system into living software.

sections.title: The results
sections.description: Strategy, brand and tooling working as one system produced real momentum: BattMobility grew from 2,000 to 3,000 users, a 50% increase, with a brand and a toolset built to keep scaling. Freedom in Motion, delivered.

seo: Glossy partnered with BattMobility on a full-service brand transformation: go-to-market strategy, visual identity, a 2025 design system, AI-driven imagery and a suite of custom marketing apps, helping shared mobility grow from 2,000 to 3,000 users under the banner Freedom in Motion.

name: Fanfinity

sections.title: The challenge
sections.description: How to merge 2 companies under 1 name and ensure that their mission (creating better fan experiences) shines through the new brand. Tournamentcenter & We Are Esports joined forces under a fresh name: Fanfinity. An agency on a mission: creating meaningful fan experiences for game publishers and brands looking to establish lasting bonds with gaming communities, empowering gaming culture.

sections.title: The mission
sections.description: Fanfinity is dedicated to lowering barriers and making gaming accessible and inclusive for all. Their diverse team has extensive experience in gaming, events and community building. Fanfinity connects people and brands online and offline to create long-term professional relationships. Together, they bring their enthusiasm and creativity to projects to create meaningful fan experiences and share happiness to strengthen gaming culture.

sections.title: The brand identity
sections.description: The entire brand identity is built using a grid system inspired by the aesthetics of popular trading card games. Simplified into four (and more) versatile shapes, the design system offers flexibility in every application. The fresh and youthful brand colours resonate with fans and publishers/brands alike. TT Commons was selected as the font, radiating a friendly appearance perfectly aligned with the Fanfinity team.

sections.title: Brand Experience
sections.description: To ensure consistent communication across all touch points, we conducted a thorough brand check, refreshing each point of interaction. This included new merchandise, business cards, mailing templates, social media templates and much more. And, of course, the icing on the cake was the agency's new website. We also had the honour of designing the stand for Fanfinity's unveiling of their new name at FTI (Flanders Technology & Innovation), allowing them to showcase their brand to the public.

seo: Formerly known as Tournamentcenter, together with the Fanfinity team, we rebranded the organization to become a fancentric agency. Fanfinity creates meaningful fan experiences for game publishers and brands looking to establish lasting bonds with gaming communities. Their team of experts has a deep passion for gaming culture and communities. With their tailored approach, they aim to share their excitement to create meaningful and lasting bonds between gaming communities and their clients.

name: The Smiles
slogan: Entertainment Gallery A place where smiles are created.

sections.title: The Challenge
sections.description:
At the request of former mayor Leopold Lippens, Valerie Vanhonsebrouck took on the challenge of building a new entertainment complex in Knokke. With over 10,000m2 of space for bowling, karting, dining and more, Valerie enlisted our help in branding the venue.

Welcome to The Smiles - Entertainment Gallery, Knokke's premier indoor hotspot for fun and excitement. Come to a world of entertainment, where laughter and adventure await around every corner.

sections.title: About The Brand
sections.description:
The Smiles offers innovative entertainment in a family-friendly environment. With 10,000 m2 of varied activities, state-of-the art bowling, Tag Active, challenging karting (coming soon), arcade games, karaoke, indoor & outdoor playground, pool & darts, all in a unique interior, it is the Entertainment Gallery of Knokke-Heist.

Enjoy a day full of fun with your family and friends, cosy & delicious food and smiles from our dedicated Smile Providers.

sections.title: The Brand Identity
sections.description:
The goal was to design a logo that conveys both fun and elegance. We took inspiration from the Entertainment Gallery's interior lighting and designed a logo that puts a smile on your face at first glance. Reflecting the youthful, positive and joyful spirit of the venue, with a touch of sophistication, our logo perfectly captures the spirit of The Smiles.

With a vibrant colour palette, bold typography and playful graphics, the brand stands out from it's competitors and invites customers to experience the excitement inside.

sections.title: Art Direction
sections.description:
The brand evokes warmth, joy and happiness, which is reflected in its extensive colour palette of inviting, vibrant hues. This approachable and human feel is consistent across all touchpoints. Using the power of motion, we bring the brand to life. The bowling LED wall displays dynamic animations that blend seamlessly into the interior.

Consistency is key in every aspect of our brand story, the menu card is attractive and invites you to enjoy one of the restaurant's delicious meals. Authentic imagery, capturing real smiles from real visitors, enhances the welcoming atmosphere.

‍

sections.title: Imagery
sections.description: We took on the challenge of visually capturing the brand identity through bright imagery, taking inspiration from The Smiles' interior. Authentic people add a human touch that embodies the essence of The Smiles. Each activity was carefully recorded, filling the website with original images that make the brand authentic.

sections.title: Website
sections.description:
The full brand story is seamlessly integrated into all our deliverables. We delivered clear social media templates, but the website is the ultimate focal point for the brand.

Our user-friendly website design highlights all of The Smiles' activities and packages. With a clear user interface, we make it easy for visitors to explore the wide range of activities.

seo: We are proud to reveal the new brand identity for The Smiles, an indoor entertainment hotspot, where people gather to chill, have fun, and explore exciting new activities. Our ultimate goal is to create smiles and spread happiness to every visitor.

name: Madison.Partners
intro:
About the brand

Glossy Branding Agency had the honor of rebranding Madison.Partners, a leading Data Strategy Consultancy firm based in Ghent, with offices in New York and Singapore. Collaborating closely with the Madison.Partners team, we developed a comprehensive brand strategy that sets the stage for their growth and expansion in the coming years.

The Madison.Partners rebrand exudes professionalism, experience and expertise, while highlighting the talented individuals who craft data strategies. Drawing inspiration from the topographic lines of Silicon Valley and 3D visualizations of data, the brand now boasts a dynamic and modern aesthetic. We also designed a website that seamlessly integrates all brand elements, providing a cohesive and engaging user experience.
seo: Glossy Branding Agency had the honor of rebranding Madison.Partners, a leading Data Strategy Consultancy firm based in Ghent, with offices in New York and Singapore. Collaborating closely with the Madison.Partners team, we developed a comprehensive brand strategy that sets the stage for their growth and expansion in the coming years.

name: Bravosix
intro:
About the brand

Bravosix is an independent interior design agency based in Ostend, Belgium. Founder Nicolas Delahaye asked us to develop a brand that matches his own personality. A brand in which simplicity is key, but with the proper twist. Based on our thorough strategic ideation sessions, we developed a brand strategy with a strong 'no-nonsense' approach. Bravosix always strives to deliver ideas & designs that become outstanding projects, meeting the high standards of all clients. The brand identity reflects this mindset. We chose a neutral colour palette with orange as a bold accent colour. The orange is echoed in the professional photography. The use of large fonts provides the eye-catcher the brand deserves.
seo: Bravosix is an independent interior design agency based in Ostend, Belgium. Founder Nicolas Delahaye asked us to develop a brand that matches his own personality. A brand in which simplicity is key, but with the proper twist.

name: The Payroll Office
slogan: Personal payroll management and advice for the entrepreneurial employer
testimonial: “We came to Glossy when we were looking for a partner to assist us in branding our new social agency. Glossy didn't just provide us with a nice logo, fun colours & a great story, they made us start thinking about our strategy and where we want to go in the future. A full-service package tailored to our start-up with the necessary support before, during and after our journey.”

sections.title: The Challenge
sections.description: Kenny & Mathias came to us to setup a new payrolling office. They were looking for a more personal approach than the existing offices. A clear strategic framework was essential.

sections.title: Brand Ideation
sections.description: Together with The Payroll Office, we have discovered many valuable insights that form the foundation of an innovative strategy in the payrolling sector. A personal approach & accessible consultancy are the key principles of the brand.

sections.title: Concept Validation
sections.description: A brief market survey quickly made it clear that the need for unrecognised payrolling offices is very high in Flanders. Small and mid-size enterprises are especially looking for a payroll partner that offers them tailor-made personal advice.

sections.title: Brand Opportunities
sections.description: To ensure that The Payroll Office stands out in the crowd of payrolling offices, we opt for a very transparent pricing. So transparently that they are listed on the website. This has never been done before.The Payroll Office decisively chooses accessible consultancy that helps entrepreneurs flourish.

sections.title: Brand Definition
sections.description: We defined the brand as a personal payroll partner for the entrepreneurial employer. The Payroll Office offers customised, to-the-point consultancy in the language of the entrepreneur. This allows them to focus on running their business instead of personnel administration.

sections.title: Positioning
sections.description: You are not a number at The Payroll Office. We position the company as a very personal and transparent brand. You can expect payroll management with no surprises and a fixed package price per employee. In addition, The Payroll Office offers accessible consultancy thanks to their years of expertise. This makes it possible for smalland mid-size enterprises to receive grounded and tailor-made advice.

sections.title: Art Direction
sections.description: The logo of The Payroll Office was formed out of a pay slip. The personal aspect is reflected in the fingerprint present in the logo. The wave motion of the letter P translates “the pay” and“the roll”. We opted for a remarkable colour palette and a font that highlights the young and dynamic character of this company.

sections.title: Imagery
sections.description: We put the founders of The Payroll Office centre stage with a very personal visual language. This fits perfectly with the graphic brand identity. We chose images with a high level of light and human interaction. This way, we stay true to the mission of the brand.

sections.title: Tone Of Voice
sections.description: The baseline - personal payroll management and advice for the entrepreneurial employer - was chosen as secondary communication. The tone of voice of The Payroll Office is young and transparent but always professional and informal.

sections.title: Brand Templates
sections.description: The brand templates feature a playful graphic element. The Pantone print provides a vibrant colour that highlights the dynamic character of the brand.

sections.title: Website
sections.description: For The Payroll Office, we developed a clear one-pager that highlights the full brand experience. The personal character also emerges here. It was made very easy for potential customers to schedule a meeting with the founders.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.description: Convenient templates ensure consistent communication of The Payroll Office across all social media channels. An animated launch video provides the push the brand needs to grow on social media.

sections.title: PR & Communications
sections.description: We issued a press release that was sent to all West Flemish media channels. This was picked up by several press agencies. This way, we created an enormous boost in brand awareness for The Payroll Office.

seo: Kenny & Mathias came to us to set up a new payrolling office. They were looking for a more personal approach than the existing offices. A clear strategic framework was essential.

name: BuddyBites
baseline: Customised Dog Food For Your Buddy
slogan: Tailor-made dog food for your buddy. Personalised, Healthy & Delivered at Home.

sections.title: The Challenge
sections.description: Charlotte & Mattijs, two Vlerick Marketing students, approached Glossy Branding Agency with the request to assist them in the development of a new brand. A concept for online dog food. A service that delivers tailor-made and healthy dog food to your home. Together we built BuddyBites, a subscription model for tailor-made healthy dog food.

sections.title: Brand Ideation
sections.description: Using our brand questionnaire, we sat down with the founders during three ideation sessions. Here, we decided together why the startup is doing what they are doing and how they want to communicate this to their target audience.

sections.title: Concept Validation
sections.description: For several years now, the 'Humanisation of Pets' has also been on the rise in Belgium. This term stands for the fact that true animal lovers increasingly see their animal as a real member of their family. It is safe to say that animal and owner(s) have a deeply rooted bond of trust, with many similarities to a real (human) relationship. As humans, we also want to eat healthier and healthier food, this is equally true for our pets. So it was more than obvious that a concept like BuddyBites is needed in Belgium.

sections.title: Brand Opportunities
sections.description: It was not yet possible for buddy owners to order customised food for their pets online in Belgium. The opportunities for the brand are therefore very great to take a large share of the market for this through their unique BuddyPas. Using this pass, BuddyBites makes personalised and tasty food. This always at the right price for your buddy.

sections.title: Naming
sections.description: The name speaks for itself, our pets are increasingly becoming our friends hence we choose Buddy. This young term feels playful, just like our pets. Also, the focus is always on healthy and tasty food: the Bites. Say hello to BuddyBites.

sections.title: Brand Definition
sections.description: BuddyBites is defined as a brand that prepares quality food mixes tailored to your pet. Tell BuddyBites everything about your pet on their interactive platform, and their algorithm prepares the right unique & healthy food mix. That way, you and your pet can enjoy a longer and more active friendship together!

sections.title: Purpose
sections.description: Just as allergens are becoming more common in humans, this is also the case for our pets. However, for many dogs, the supply is too limited and it is not possible to obtain healthy dog food adapted to their allergy. BuddyBites' mission is to help all pets live healthier lives tailored to their needs. The nutritional substances are therefore always screened for sustainability and transparency. All BuddyBites products contain only healthy building blocks.

sections.title: Trademark
sections.description: Using our own naming strategy, it was possible to also trademark the brand. BuddyBites was registered in Benelux & France. In this way, the trademark is protected against other identities that might want to use the name or logo in their own communications. As a result, the trademark always provides a strategic advantage.

sections.title: Proposition
sections.description: BuddyBites is a brand that personally helps and guides animal lovers in their pet's wellbeing, by creating a nutritional schedule together with the customer, BuddyBites can and translate it into a unique, tailor-made nutritional mix. BuddyBites can guarantee 100% improvement, truly helping both animal and owner. BuddyBites is an honest & transparent brand, helping to optimise and improve the future health of the animal. BuddyBites is a new player that uses innovative techniques to help improve the well-being of pets and their owners.

sections.title: Art Direction
sections.description: The logo is balanced throughout in X-Y axis. The logo also seamlessly complements the wordmark, which was designed in the Nunito Font. Continuing this font gives the brand a young, dynamic but reliable feel. The colours are bright and happy and complement the pets. As a pattern, we use the fur of the buddies to reflect the animal aspect of the brand.

sections.title: Imagery
sections.description: The Buddies are always at the centre of BuddyBites' imagery. In studio images, the pets are always on a background in one of our brand colours. In atmospheric images, we use the BuddyBites box as much as possible to continue the brand identity in the visual language.

sections.title: Tone Of Voice
sections.description: The BuddyBites Tone of Voice is very honest and transparent. To address the young nature of the brand, we also often use humour in the identity. We inform and guide consumers in a cool way with fun slogans. The baseline food for friends sums up the essence of the brand.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.description: BuddyBites is the brainchild of Mattijs Brandt and Charlotte Coene. They believe that, as with humans, nutrients are the basis for any pet's well-being. When Sky - Charlotte's brother's dog - developed a skin allergy, together they began a search for the right healthy solution. They soon realised that the current market for healthy pet food offered a wide range of solutions, but none appeared to be unique and tailor-made to their specific needs. That is why they founded BuddyBites in 2019. With the brand, they want to guarantee healthy and tasty tailor-made dog food that also gives effective and long-term results that really benefit your pet.

sections.title: Packaging
sections.description: The BuddyBites Box is a fixture of the brand. It is the first offline contact moment customers have with the identity. Consequently, with every delivery, customers always see some happy dogs. Each bag of food also always features your pet's unique Buddy pass.

sections.title: Products
sections.description: The full brand was continued in a product line including salmon oil for a better coat. Biscuit rolls with lamb and apple. Essential vitamins that give the right boost to your buddy. Jummy strips and, of course, pooping bags for when the need arises.

seo: Charlotte & Mattijs, two students from Vlerick Marketing, approached Glossy Branding Agency to assist them in the development of a new brand. A concept for online dog food. It provides a service that delivers tailor-made and healthy dog food at home. Together we built BuddyBites, a subscription model for customised healthy dog food. BuddyBites is defined as a brand that prepares quality food mixes tailored to your pet. Tell BuddyBites everything about your pet on their interactive platform, and their algorithm will prepare the right unique & healthy food mix. This way you and your pet can enjoy a longer and more active friendship!

name: Miles Ahead
baseline: Producing the future of Deep Tech & AI
slogan: Producing the future of Deep Tech & AI
founders: Luc Burgelman Wim De Waele Maarten Mortier Frederik Lebeer

sections.title: Brand Analysis
sections.description: The brand analysis showed that the venture studio model is not yet widely known in Belgium. Therefore, it is very important that the proposal of Miles Ahead is communicated in abite-size manner.

sections.title: Brand Definition
sections.description: The brand is defined as a venture studio that helps first-time Deep Tech & AI founders grow by producing and funding their business in a stimulating environment. The personal aspect is very important here, hence the deliberate choice of using people in the brand.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.description: It is the mission of Miles Ahead to shorten the learning curve of early stage Deep Tech & AI startups by producing their business together with the Miles Ahead experts. Through this short and intensive creative process, Miles Ahead accelerates the go-to-market.This way, they help increase the return for the founder.

sections.title: Art Direction
sections.description: We used the sound waves of the originalMiles Ahead song as the base for the new logo. In this manner, we clearly refer to the role that is taken as a producer. The colour palette was chosen based on the first Miles Ahead album, these vibrant colours are the foundation of a distinctive brand. The colours in combination with the selected font give the brand a technical character.

sections.title: Imagery
sections.description: To reflect the venture studio's personal approach, we portray Miles Ahead's professionals in their environment.

sections.title: 3D Imagery
sections.description: We choose a visual language that fits the brand and clearly appeals to our target audience, with an emphasis on technology and data. By using an icon and a defined colour palette, we can design an unlimited set of 3D images that always fit the brand identity.

sections.title: Website
sections.description: We developed a website that is clearly aimed at the founders. A convenient CMS ensures that the operating partners can easily provide updates on the ins and outs of the venture studio.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.description: Social media templates were delivered to ensure that everyone from the venture studio could communicate within the brand identity in a simple manner. This way, the thought leadership of MilesAhead is emphasised.

seo: Creating a brand for a venture studio that specializes in Deep Tech & AI with a love for music. Here, the people behind tech are placed in front. Miles Ahead is a Venture Studio helping first-time founders of Deep Tech & AI startups grow faster by producing and funding their business within an empowering environment.

name: Dragòn
baseline: Belgian Beer Culture At Its Finest
slogan: Belgian Beer Culture At Its Finest
intro:
About the brand

Welcome to Dragòn, an "International Premium Beer Café" in the heart of Ghent. Our bar is located in the historic center in Klein Turkey, just opposite the Sint-Niklaaskerk, situated on the Korenmarkt in Ghent.

In addition to 30 beers from Belgian brewers on tap, we also offer delicious Dierendonck food pairing as well as mind-blowing beer cocktails & boiler makers. You can also taste a selection of unique beers that mature in our maturation cabinet. Don't forget our own Dragòn beer in barrel!
founders: Jean-Michel Teerlink Julien Malingreau Bart Meyskens
seo: Welcome to Dragòn, an "International Premium Beer Café" in the heart of Ghent. Our bar is located in the historic center in Klein Turkey, just opposite the Sint-Niklaaskerk, situated on the Korenmarkt in Ghent.

name: The Leaf
intro:
About the brand

Back in 2016, Glossy Branding Agency was asked to help develop a sustainable & future-proof brand for a new retail park at the old Ikea site in Ternat (Brussels). We proposed a 18h during ideation session, based on our Branding Through Strategy© ideology. We developed the right values, services, tone of voice and go to market strategy. After an intense naming exercise, The Leaf was born. Our clever art direction translated the entire concept in a contemporary - yet accessible - look & feel, without overusing the typical greenwashing style.

What is the Leaf? "At The Leaf Shopping Ternat, shopping is fun and relaxing. During and after shopping you can enjoy our various bars & restaurants. The site is constructed with sustainable materials, and is located in a green environment. The Leaf Shopping Ternat offers charging points for electric cars and bicycles. Walking and cycling paths are laid out on site for pedestrians and cyclists. There is a wide selection of 19 stores all under one roof. The Leaf is easily accessible by public transport and if you visit our site by car, we offer free parking space. We know kids like to play, they can run and jump in our playground while you do the shopping!"

The Leaf is a future-proof retail park, that continues to focus on raising awareness for a better tomorrow.

Pictures ©2018 Redevco • Video footage ©2018 Clouds
seo: Back in 2016, Glossy Branding Agency was asked to help develop a sustainable & future-proof brand for a new retail park at the old Ikea site in Ternat (Brussels). We proposed a 18h during ideation session, based on our Branding Through Strategy© ideology.

name: The Growcery
intro:
About the brand

In the summer of 2018, P&G asked Glossy Branding Agency to help in building, naming & visualising their new 'open innovation platform'. Based on their in house inqbet strategy, P&G wanted to share and combine the knowledge with other companies serving the FMCG market. Glossy Branding Agency implemented 4 workshops with the stakeholders of P&G, B-Ops & The Bridge. Together we created a new brand called The Growcery!

"The Growcery is a place where brands and start-ups team up to maximize the success of consumer-centric products and business models, as a European collaborative innovation platform, we connect innovative consumer brands and technology startups & scale-ups in a consumer-centric community. By doing so, we aim at boosting the chances of success of new product launches and accelerating the internationalization of local startups & scale-ups, creating a win-win for all parties"
seo: In the summer of 2018, P&G asked glossy.tv to help in building, naming & visualising their new 'open innovation platform'. Based on their in house inqbet strategy, P&G wanted to share and combine the knowledge with other companies serving the FMCG market.

name: KAA Gent
baseline: Identity for an iconic soccer team
slogan: Identity for an iconic soccer team
intro:
About the case

Introducing the new era of KAA Gent, the iconic soccer team since 1895, affectionately known as the "BUFFALO'S" since 1924. Glossy Branding Agency took up the challenge to create a powerful team identity centered around the inspiring slogan, "The future starts here."

With a rich history symbolized by the enduring indian logo, Glossy Branding Agency crafted a strong and modern brand that captures the spirit of the club. Notably, KAA Gent clinched the national championship in the 2014-2015 season, solidifying their place in the hearts of fans.

Get ready to cheer on the Buffalo's as they lead the way to a bright future. Buffalo!
seo: A new soccer arena, a new identity. KAA Gent (since 1895), also called the 'BUFFALO'S' since 1924, uses an indian as their logo. For many years, the indian logo never changed, and multiple versions of the logo were used.

name: Pukkelpop 2018
baseline: Love will tear us apart, again.
slogan: Love will tear us apart, again.

About the case

For over 30 years Pukkelpop selects a musical line-up with an alternative fringe. The festival has become one of Europe’s greatest outdoor music events with more than 250 current musical sensations, living legends and visionary alternative artists. It’s fun, relaxed, varied and very much built around the love of music!
seo: For over 30 years Pukkelpop selects a musical line-up with an alternative fringe. The festival has become one of Europe’s greatest outdoor music events with more than 250 current musical sensations, living legends and visionary alternative artists. It’s fun, relaxed, varied and very much built around the love of music!

name: Scale-Ups.eu
intro:
About the case

In March 2018, Scale-Ups.eu emerged as an international ecosystem for scale-ups, driven by tech entrepreneur Jurgen Ingels. It aims to be the go-to platform for scale-ups in Europe, connecting them with investors and facilitating collaborations with high-tech companies and research organizations.

For Scale-Ups.eu Glossy Branding Agency crafted a modern and engaging brand presence across online and offline channels. Scale-Ups.eu accelerates growth and optimizes time for scale-ups, global VCs, and a vast network of partners.

Experience the fresh and contemporary approach of Scale-Ups.eu today.
seo: In March 2018, a new international ecosystem is born for scale-ups. Led by serial tech entrepreneur Jurgen Ingels, Scale-Ups.eu aims to become the top-of-mind time squeezer for scale-ups in Europe.

name: The Potato Bar
slogan: A surreal real brand for The Potato Bar in Bruges

sections.title: The Challenge
sections.description: Kevin and Ramses came to Glossy because they wanted to start a friterie in Bruges, a city which already has a lot of them. The challenge was to create a friterie that would stand out. The two friends left with all the ingredients to make their dream a reality.

sections.title: Brand Ideation
sections.description: During our ideation sessions, it became clear that we needed to make the brand unique in all its experiences. We achieved this through original recipes such as the Veganaise and the Mary of Burgundy. In addition, we chose sustainable Belgian ingredients throughout the menu to emphasise the local character of The Potato Bar in the entire brand story.

sections.title: Concept Validation
sections.description: After a thorough competitor analysis, it became clear that the numerous friteries in Bruges always offer the same experience to their customers. To make sure that The Potato Bar concept would catch on, it was very important for The Potato Bar to distinguish itself from its competitors by offering a unique experience.

sections.title: Cultural Context
sections.description: Bruges is annually visited by almost 8 million tourists, who want to taste Belgian culture. At The Potato Bar they can enjoy this quite literally because the brand combines the best of what Belgium has to offer. We found it crucial that the bar not only becomes a tourist attraction, but also that the real Bruges inhabitants can go there for their favourite fries and an original croquette or hamburger.

sections.title: Brand Definition
sections.description: We define the brand of The Potato Bar as an eatery that combines all the best that Belgium has to offer, creating all our products with great care in order to always guarantee the typical Belgian taste. In addition, we chose to combine the friterie with a cozy bar in an original way.

sections.title: Storytelling
sections.description: Ramses and Kevin have been good friends for 10 years and together they wanted to make their entrepreneurial dream come true. They aim to serve Belgian fries in a less traditional and more unique way. With their experience as chefs, they were able to fulfil this dream with The Potato Bar. Expect extraordinary flavour combinations with the greatest love for the potato and for Belgian cuisine.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.description: As a typical Bruges brand, The Potato Bar considers it important that their products are home-made and genuine. The Potato Bar therefore always opts for local and sustainable ingredients with the utmost respect for Belgian culture.

sections.title: Art Direction
sections.description: The logo is inspired by the act of peeling a potato. By working with vintage illustrations in the graphic identity, we created an authentic experience. The colour palette was deliberately kept simple, we chose black, white and brown. We used the brown for the kraft paper because it gives it an artisan feel. As fonts, we chose ‘Akzidenz’ and ‘Gotham’.

sections.title: Imagery
sections.description: The visual language of The Potato Bar is unique, playful and atmospheric. We chose images full of light that focus on the pleasant atmosphere and the delicious food. The food photography portrays authentically the unique and tasteful combinations for which the brand is known.

sections.title: Copywriting
sections.description: English was chosen as the brand language for The Potato Bar. Always with a young and rough tone. The names of the dishes are also always original.

sections.title: Website
sections.description: The website of The Potato Bar is the place where the online brand experience is paramount. Therefore, a user-friendly and fresh website is extremely important to convince consumers.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.description: Convenient social media templates ensure that The Potato Bar can approach their audience in a consistent manner on all relevant social media channels. This with an amusing approach, because humour works.

sections.title: Offline Brand Tools
sections.description: The menus were printed on kraft paper just like the placemats and all other flyers. This way, the artisanal feeling returns.

sections.title: Spatial Design
sections.description: We created a clear moodboard that was delivered to the interior designer to ensure that the brand experience of The Potato Bar was complete.

seo: Kevin and Ramses came to Glossy because they wanted to start a friterie in Bruges, a city which already has a lot of them. The challenge was to create a friterie that would stand out.

name: La Vie
intro:
About the case

La Vie Ostend entrusted Glossy Branding Agency to develop a new strategy for their restaurant. La Vie takes fusion food to the next level with its "around the world in 6 dishes" philosophy. The innovative soul food and cutting-edge cocktails are designed for a memorable food pairing experience.

name: Quick-Step Floors Pro Cycling Team 2017
baseline: A new year, a new identity
slogan: A new year, a new identity
intro:
About the case

For the 2017 season, Glossy Branding Agency was given the exciting opportunity to develop the comprehensive team identity for the newly formed Quick-Step Pro Cycling Team. Drawing from our passion for cycling, we embarked on a journey to create a fresh and contemporary identity for one of the most renowned teams in the peloton.

From the eye-catching jerseys to the carefully designed stationery and various deliverables, Glossy Branding Agency left no stone unturned to create a cohesive and visually engaging brand experience for the team. With attention to detail and a deep understanding of the cycling world, we ensured that every aspect of the team's identity exuded professionalism and style.

The result is a brand identity that not only reflects the team's iconic status, but also captures the essence of their dynamic and competitive spirit. Glossy Branding Agency is proud to have contributed to the success of the Quick-Step Pro Cycling Team through our design expertise.

name: B-Hive
intro:
About the case

Glossy Branding Agency took on the exciting task of creating a comprehensive branding for B-Hive, a collaborative fintech platform in Europe. Through an intensive ideation process, Glossy Branding Agency developed a unique naming, a captivating baseline, and a compelling storytelling approach for the platform.

To enhance the visual identity of B-Hive, Glossy Branding Agency designed over 15 illustrations that are versatile and can be seamlessly integrated across various communication channels. These illustrations are adaptable for use in motion graphics, web design, and print materials, ensuring a cohesive and engaging brand experience.

The result of Glossy Branding Agency's branding efforts is a distinct and cohesive identity that captures the essence of B-Hive as a collaborative innovation platform in the fintech industry. The comprehensive branding allows B-Hive to effectively communicate its mission, engage with its target audience, and build bridges between established financial institutions and the vibrant start-up and scale-up community.

Pictures ©2017 Marieke Penne
seo: Glossy Branding Agency took on the exciting task of creating a comprehensive branding for B-Hive, a collaborative fintech platform in Europe. Through an intensive ideation process, Glossy Branding Agency developed a unique naming, a captivating baseline, and a compelling storytelling approach for the platform.

name: Element Architecten
baseline: When less is so much more
slogan: When less is so much more
intro:
About the case

Element Architects, a firm driven by the desire to build and create, approached Glossy Branding Agency with a unique challenge. They sought a brand identity that would embody their "less is more" philosophy, while remaining recognizable yet understated. The task at hand was to strike a delicate balance between minimalism and design, understanding that true simplicity isn't achieved by removing everything, but by preserving essential elements.

Glossy Branding Agency embraced the challenge and set out to craft a brand for Element Architects that would seamlessly blend into the background while maintaining a distinct presence. Through meticulous design and thoughtful execution, we created a visual identity that exudes simplicity and elegance. Every element was carefully considered, ensuring that nothing was superfluous or lacking in purpose.

The resulting brand for Element Architects stands as a testament to the successful fusion of minimalism and design. It showcases the firm's commitment to refined craftsmanship and their ability to create spaces that embody the essence of less is more.
seo: Element Architects, a firm driven by the desire to build and create, approached Glossy Branding Agency with a unique challenge. They sought a brand identity that would embody their "less is more" philosophy, while remaining recognizable yet understated.

name: iMinds
intro:
About the case

In the magical year 2010, the Flemish funded IBBT felt the urge to become a brand that was more easy to communicate. After all, IBBT was a too technical name for a company that had one core business: Innovation. Glossy.tv won the pitch and developed a campaign based social media strategy, video strategy and even offline video boxes. The campaign was quite a success, and iMinds attracted more young potentials, the entrepreneurs of tomorrow. We described iMinds as followed:

'IBBT has a new name. We are now called iMinds.

Our new name reflects that we need more than technology to tackle major societal challenges. That’s why our organization relies on world-class researchers and entrepreneurs from different backgrounds. iMinds covers it all. By now, ICT is everywhere and touches upon many aspects of our daily lives such as healthcare, culture & media, the environment, mobility and security. We strive for excellence in science and business and support young entrepreneurs in achieving their dream as it is our ambition to create a lasting & positive impact on society through information technology.'
seo: 'IBBT has a new name. We are now called iMinds. Our new name reflects that we need more than technology to tackle major societal challenges. That’s why our organization relies on world-class researchers and entrepreneurs from different backgrounds.

name: Filliers Dry Gin 28
baseline: A new Belgian Gin with 28 botanicals
slogan: A new Belgian Gin with 28 botanicals
intro:
About the case

Filliers Dry Gin 28, a handcrafted premium gin with a rich heritage, has been a hallmark of excellence since 1880. Infused and distilled with 28 meticulously selected botanicals, this gin is a testament to the artistry of the Master Distiller at Filliers Distillery.

In 2011, Glossy Branding Agency had the privilege of collaborating with Filliers Distillery to develop and design a new product. With a carefully crafted strategic plan, a new gin was brought to life under the guidance of Bernard Filliers. The result was a gin that embodied the essence of craftsmanship and innovation.

Today, Filliers Dry Gin 28 continues to captivate gin enthusiasts with its exquisite flavors and timeless appeal. It stands as a testament to the partnership between Filliers Distillery and Glossy Branding Agency, combining tradition and modernity to create a truly remarkable gin.
seo: Filliers Dry Gin 28, a handcrafted premium gin with a rich heritage, has been a hallmark of excellence since 1880. Infused and distilled with 28 meticulously selected botanicals, this gin is a testament to the artistry of the Master Distiller at Filliers Distillery.

name: Pukkelpop 2017
intro:
About the case

Welcome home to Pukkelpop! Glossy Branding Agency took the developed branding from 2015 and transformed it into an exciting new campaign. Pukkelpop is not just about music; it's about the collective experience. Together we create the vibrant atmosphere that makes it feel like home.

Glossy Branding Agency was once again commissioned to create the full look and feel of Pukkelpop, both online and offline. For the 2017 edition, we embraced the power of video walls to enhance on-site communication. We created a comprehensive video style guide, allowing third parties to seamlessly integrate their branding into the overall visual experience.

Partners such as Proximus, Alken-Maes, Coca-Cola, Lipton Ice Tea, Humo and many others found it effortless to align their branding with the integrated communications strategy. We look forward to seeing you again next year at Pukkelpop, where we will continue to create unforgettable moments together.
seo: Welcome home to Pukkelpop! Glossy Branding Agency took the developed branding from 2015 and transformed it into an exciting new campaign. Pukkelpop is not just about music; it's about the collective experience. Together we create the vibrant atmosphere that makes it feel like home.

name: Café Costume Booth 2017
intro:
About the case

Glossy Branding Agency joined forces with the Café Costume team to embark on a journey of modernizing their brand. Drawing inspiration from the rich heritage of European textile ateliers, we delved into the history of the garments industry. Tiles, a prevalent element in textile factories, became a focal point in our design approach, symbolizing the deep-rooted heritage of the brand.

By incorporating this element into the new visual identity, Glossy Branding Agency successfully infused Café Costume with a touch of modernism while paying homage to its historical roots. This exciting collaboration sets the stage for even more innovative and forward-thinking initiatives from Café Costume in the future. Stay tuned for the evolution of Café Costume's modern aesthetic!

name: Night Shift 2018
intro:

Night Shift fosters collaboration among young entrepreneurs, providing them with unique co-creation platforms across Belgium. This event serves as a bridge between startups and established businesses, fostering a vibrant ecosystem of innovation and growth.

Moving away from traditional photography and set design, the entire online and offline campaign was brought to life through immersive 3D modeling and animation. This innovative approach allowed for greater creative freedom and resulted in visually captivating and engaging content that reflected the forward-thinking nature of Night Shift.

By leveraging the power of 3D technology, Glossy Branding Agency successfully captured the essence of Night Shift, showcasing its dynamic and collaborative spirit in a visually stunning and compelling manner.

The company works their magic by transforming several locations in Belgium to a co-creation platform for young entrepreneurs. Night Shift is an event where start ups and (international) established businesses walk hand in hand.

name: Moovly
baseline: Rebranding of an online video animation software platform
slogan: Rebranding of an online video animation software platform
intro:
About the case

Moovly, with its impressive track record, has revolutionized the world of online content creation in under 5 years. Their platform enables users to effortlessly create videos, presentations, e-cards, and more, all from scratch. Seeking to redefine their go-to-market strategy and overall identity, Moovly approached Glossy Branding Agency for a transformative solution.

In today's landscape, where convenience, stunning results, and deep insights are paramount for users, Glossy Branding Agency devised a strategy for Moovly to lead the way as an expert and thought leader. By positioning Moovly as a product brand rather than just a company, with an effortless and digitally-focused identity, Moovly aims to flip the funnel and prioritize the user experience. It's all about providing an affordable, intuitive, and simple cloud-based platform that empowers everyone to create captivating animated videos.

Don't just take our word for it. Give it a try yourself!

‍

name: SVNTY
intro:
About the case

When FC70, the renowned Antwerp fashion agency, approached us to reshape their own brand SVNTY, it felt like a dream come true. With great pleasure, we embarked on a journey with founders Miguel & Gregory and their team, aiming to transform SVNTY into a brand that defies conventions. SVNTY: Handy, witty and a touch mischievous. Let us elaborate.

SVNTY is not your average Antwerp fashion brand; it is a statement for women and children who crave a life beyond the ordinary. It encompasses an effortlessly stylish look with a unique attitude. What sets SVNTY apart is its commitment to exceptional quality at accessible prices. Whether you're picking up the kids from school, attending that important lunch, meeting Ryan Gosling or going out, SVNTY makes sure it's always showtime, front and center. Stop Making Sense!

As a unique event venue in the bustling tourist district, Ray offers a multifaceted experience. It is a place to relax, socialize, enjoy drinks and party. But Ray goes beyond just partying by providing an indoor children's playground for our young adventurers. Discover the allure of Ray in Ghent, perfectly located between City Hall and Korenmarkt.

name: Café Costume x Glossy

About the case

The Café Costume x Glossy Branding Agency Opaque linings draw inspiration from the timeless beauty of marble, renowned for its intricate patterns and cultural significance. Marble has been a symbol of tradition and refined taste for centuries, favored by sculptors, architects, and connoisseurs. Its diverse colors and elegant surface make it a luxurious and decorative material. The collaboration between Glossy Branding Agency and Café Costume has produced memorable visuals, linings, and campaigns, reflecting the brand's commitment to quality.

For the 2016 season, Glossy Branding Agency aimed to create a collection of exclusive marble linings, featuring names like Carrara, Onyx, and Negro Marquina, embodying the essence of luxury and sophistication.

Opaque: Rock solid exclusivity.

name: Miia
baseline: A San Francisco based Artificial Intelligence Company
slogan: A San Francisco based Artificial Intelligence Company

About the case

In an era of rapid technological advancement, the next significant disruption has arrived: Artificial Intelligence (AI). It's not just a future concept; AI is already transforming industries. At the forefront of this revolution is Miia, a pioneering organization that empowers businesses to build future-proof business models.

By harnessing the power of AI, Miia enables machines to comprehend text with human-like understanding, leading to significant cost reductions and increased efficiency. We collaborated with Miia to redefine their brand communication and reposition them in the market. Through strategic messaging and impactful storytelling, we highlighted Miia's groundbreaking capabilities, establishing them as a trailblazer in the AI landscape.
seo: Ai is the next big disruption, even better, artificial Intelligence is already here. Miia helps your organisation in building the business models of the future. Reduce your costs drastically by enabling machines to understand text like you and me would. We helped the brand to reposition in the market by changing the brand's communication.

name: The Breakfast Club
slogan: Brand Identity for a production company
intro:
About the case

Inspired by the iconic 80's film, The Breakfast Club, our client has created a real-life haven where individuals from diverse backgrounds converge. They proudly call themselves a production company, uniting publicity agencies, creatives, directors, photographers, and brands in a shared space of curiosity, collaboration, and creation.

We had the privilege of crafting their new identity, a visual representation of their vibrant community. With their trust in our expertise, we designed a brand that captures the spirit of inclusivity, innovation, and boundless imagination that thrives within The Breakfast Club.
seo: The Breakfast Club is just like in the 80’s film a place where people from all different corners come together.

name: Night Shift 2017
intro:
About the case

In the 2017 campaign, we embraced the future with unwavering determination. The Digital Shift, a profound transformation taking place before our eyes, holds immense power to reshape brand philosophies. Night Shift, as a thought and opinion leader, recognizes the need to play a pioneering role in these ever-evolving landscapes.

As Night Shift expands its services and charts a new brand direction, the 2017 editions must boldly embrace a future perspective. With five years of Night Shift behind us, we now set our sights on another five years ahead. Examining today's market, we witness the surge of the service economy, where data emerges as the key driving force.

Data, the new gold of our era, promises to revolutionize our daily lives, and we are merely at the dawn of this transformative journey. Embrace the power of data and join us as we unlock the limitless potential it holds. Together, let's shape a future where possibilities are boundless. #DATAISTHENEWGOLD
founders: Jean-Michel Teerlinck Mathieu Luyens Maxime Lany
seo: For the 2017 campaign, we looked into the future. The Digital Shift is happening as we speak, and it’s a shift with a great amplitude. Every small digital innovation and change influences an entire brand philosophy.

name: Dominique Peeters

In this journey of transformation, you are the protagonist, and Dominique acts as your mirror, providing guidance and support.

With a steadfast commitment to results, Dominique combines expertise and personal attention to help you achieve your goals. Embrace the power of transformation and begin a journey to a healthier, stronger and more balanced self with Dominique.

The one doing it is the person in the mirror, let me hold the mirror. Dominique stands for result. We developed a complete 'premium' identity based on the 4 pillars of Dominique's philosophy.

With a modern and minimalist aesthetic, they skillfully integrate light, space and emotion, with careful attention to the unique characteristics of each site. Their mission is to efficiently guide projects from the initial planning stages to the meticulous detailing of materials and furniture design. Through a specific approach that combines passionate design and functional construction, JUMA Architects effectively creates cost-effective and personalized structures for their clients.

With a commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the intersection between design and functionality, JUMA Architects is ready to transform your architectural vision into reality.

Glossy Branding Agency worked out a complete rebranding for the 30th edition of Pukkelpop. While Pukkelpop is best known for its live music performances, it is also a discovery festival that presents more than 200 artists over four days. As a diverse, inspiring and innovative festival, clear and effective communication both online and offline is essential.To capture the dynamic and lively atmosphere of the festival, the Pukkelpop logo always appears in motion on all possible digital carriers.

Glossy Branding Agency was involved in all aspects of the new strategy: from the strategic report, art direction, website design to site decoration and merchandise. Glossy Branding Agency helped Pukkelpop stand out as more than just a music festival, through a comprehensive design approach that captures the spirit and values of the festival. The result is a cohesive and engaging festival experience that resonates with visitors and leaves a lasting impression.
seo: For the 30th edition of Pukkelpop, Glossy.tv developed a complete make over. Pukkelpop is more than just music, it's a discovery festival with more than 200 live artists during 4 days.

name: Night Shift 2015
baseline: All for all • All for one
slogan: All for all All for one
intro:
About the brand

For the past two years, Night Shift has successfully fulfilled its mission to connect young entrepreneurs and build a unique network. Glossy Branding Agency proposes a campaign that aligns with Night Shift's values. Today, young entrepreneurs are still looking for an effective forum to connect with each other. While there are many similar networking events and trade shows, Night Shift stands out as a platform to showcase services and products in a unique setting and atmosphere.

For the Night Shift 2015 campaign, our goal is to encourage connectivity and foster a sense of belonging among attendees. While we have not yet collected clear data on whether Night Shift events encourage crossover business, we believe that by providing a space where entrepreneurs can showcase their businesses and services, visitors have the opportunity to discover new businesses.

Our focus for 2015 is to foster an environment of collaboration and mutual support. Our campaign "One for all / All for one!" embodies the spirit of Night Shift, where participants can connect and work together to achieve their goals. By spreading this message and highlighting the benefits of Night Shift, we aim to attract more participants and foster a thriving community of entrepreneurs. Come to Night Shift to connect, collaborate and grow.
founders: Jean-Michel Teerlinck Mathieu Luyens Maxime Lany
seo: In the last two years, Night Shift made its mission statement come true. Connecting (young) entrepreneurs & building an unique (new) network. The mission is clear, and (some) success has been accomplished, Glossy.tv would like to propose a campaign, based on the company's values.

name: Café Costume
intro:
About the project

In 2010, Café Costume approached Glossy Branding Agency to design exclusive linings for their suits. As Café Costume was about to conquer the tailoring market, Glossy Branding Agency proposed a collaboration to create remarkable linings. Six unique linings were developed and all six went into production. The official release took place in the summer of 2010 and received positive feedback from the national and international press.

For an extra touch, Glossy Branding Agency collaborated with Elisabeth Ouni of apolaroidstory.com for a small, rock 'n' roll inspired PR campaign. Using 10 disposable cameras, the liners were captured in one day - with no makeup, no light, no expensive equipment and no digital technology. This authentic approach reflected the liners' raw appeal and garnered more attention.
founders: Bruno Van Gils Saskia Van Gils Angélique Van Gils
seo: Back in 2010, Café Costume asked us to design some exclusive linings for their suits. As Café Costume was on the verge of taking the tailoring market by storm, Glossy.tv decided that the linings should be a collaboration between Café Costume and Glossy.tv. We proposed six different linings and all six got in production. The official release of the linings was in the summer of 2010, and the national and international press reacted very positive.

name: Culture Club
intro:
About the project

In 2007, the Culture Club Ghent celebrated its 7th anniversary on the 7th day of the 7th month. To commemorate this special occasion, Glossy Branding Agency conceived a unique project: a remake of the iconic album cover of Queen's "Bicycle Race." Little did we know, we would find 41 enthusiastic girls, willing to model in sports underwear - graciously provided by Nike - for the photo shoot.

The day was filled with excitement as the late Luc De Vos took the stage, delivering his own rendition of the song, adding an extra layer of magic to the event. This project holds a special place in our memories.
founders: Dirk De Ruyck Thierry Bogaert Rudy Victor Ackaert
seo: Wow. This is a long time ago. But we had to add this project to our list. In the year 2007, the (legendary and not so legendary) Culture Club Ghent became 7 years.
